name: Toolbar
purpose: Horizontal group of action buttons: the title bar tools, the trash bulk strip, and the bulk action footer shown while rows are selected.

values.when: Title bar tools. gap-4, px-6, items-center, no rule.
Trash action strip. gap-3, px-6, py-5, bottom border (edge-2), shrink-0. Rendered only when at least one root exists.
Bulk action bar. h-9, top border, px-6; replaces PaneFooter while one or more rows are selected. No surface fill.

states: hidden when empty (strip, when there are no roots)
shown while one or more rows are selected (footer)
role: toolbar (proposed; the reference records no role)
keyboard: Proposed: roving focus (Radix Toolbar). Left and Right move between buttons; Tab leaves the toolbar. The reference records no keyboard handling on these groups.
open: The footer and PaneFooter share one slot, so they are separate widgets. Trash strip: B listed it under Footer row; kept here as Toolbar strip (roving focus, A). Bulk bar: B listed it under Footer; kept here as Toolbar footer. Toolbar footer is h-9, the stats footer is 32px (see PaneFooter).
